reads.command:
set -euo pipefail
ns='podpilot-test'
printf '%s\n' '=== PODS ==='
oc get pods -n "$ns" -o json | jq -r '
  ["NAME","PHASE","WAITING_REASONS"],
  (.items[] | [
    .metadata.name,
    (.status.phase // "<none>"),
    ([.status.containerStatuses[]? | select(.state.waiting != null) | ((.name // "<unnamed>") + ":" + (.state.waiting.reason // "<none>"))] | if length == 0 then "<none>" else join(",") end)
  ]) | @tsv'
printf '%s\n' '=== DEPLOYMENTS ==='
oc get deployments -n "$ns" -o json | jq -r '
  ["NAME","DESIRED","READY","AVAILABLE"],
  (.items[] | [
    .metadata.name,
    ((.spec.replicas // 1) | tostring),
    ((.status.readyReplicas // 0) | tostring),
    ((.status.availableReplicas // 0) | tostring)
  ]) | @tsv'

set -euo pipefail
ns='podpilot-test'
oc get pods,deployments -n "$ns" -o json | jq -r '
  "POD_COUNT\t" + ([.items[] | select(.kind=="Pod")] | length | tostring),
  (["POD_NAME","PHASE","WAITING_REASONS"] | @tsv),
  (.items[] | select(.kind=="Pod") | [
    .metadata.name,
    (.status.phase // "<none>"),
    ([
      ((.status.initContainerStatuses // [])[] | select(.state.waiting != null) | "init/" + .name + ":" + (.state.waiting.reason // "<none>")),
      ((.status.containerStatuses // [])[] | select(.state.waiting != null) | .name + ":" + (.state.waiting.reason // "<none>")),
      ((.status.ephemeralContainerStatuses // [])[] | select(.state.waiting != null) | "ephemeral/" + .name + ":" + (.state.waiting.reason // "<none>"))
    ] | if length == 0 then "<none>" else join(",") end)
  ] | @tsv),
  "DEPLOYMENT_COUNT\t" + ([.items[] | select(.kind=="Deployment")] | length | tostring),
  (["DEPLOYMENT_NAME","DESIRED","READY","AVAILABLE"] | @tsv),
  (.items[] | select(.kind=="Deployment") | [
    .metadata.name,
    ((.spec.replicas // 1) | tostring),
    ((.status.readyReplicas // 0) | tostring),
    ((.status.availableReplicas // 0) | tostring)
  ] | @tsv)'
